title: Kaalamellam Kaathiruppen
desc: Kannan, a man from a wealthy family, falls in love with Manimekalai, after hearing her sing in a temple, later he comes up with new ways to woo her.

title: Mirugam
desc: Ayyanar, a barbarian, beats up innocent people and rapes women. He gets married to Alagamma, a pretty girl, who hates him initially, but later decides to transform him.

title: Chinna Thambi Periya Thambi
desc: Periya Thambi and Chinna Thambi are two brothers from a poor family who fall in love with the same girl, Kavitha. However, her parents reject them due to their background.

title: Sippikkul Muthu
desc: Sivayya, a person with autism, lives in a village with his grandmother. Things take a turn when he marries a widow, Lalitha, in order to save her from the atrocities of widowhood.

title: Velaiilla Pattadhari 2
desc: Raghuvaran's career in civil engineering takes a tumultuous turn as he becomes embroiled in a fierce rivalry with Vasundhara, the powerful chairperson of a leading construction company.
